settled.error: Beurer BF720/BF105/BF500/BF788/BF950 needs a consent PIN. Set `users[].beurer_pin` in config.yaml (the code the scale was paired with in the Beurer / openScale app, or shown on the scale's control unit). If the scale was factory reset or had its batteries removed, every user slot and its code are gone; try `beurer_pin: 0`.
